cases.title: Add note button click creates and appends note div
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Add note" button creates a new note appended to the document body as a div element with the class "note".

cases.title: Created note contains a visible empty textarea
cases.description: Verify that each newly created note contains a visible, empty textarea with data-testid="note-textarea" for user input.

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on add note button create separate notes
cases.description: Verify that the application supports multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button, with each click creating a separate note containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Dynamic real-time rendering of Markdown content
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown in the textarea, the content is dynamically rendered in real-time in the main display area with proper HTML formatting.

cases.title: Handling invalid Markdown without crashes
cases.description: Verify that invalid Markdown does not cause crashes or errors, and instead displays the raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the Edit button.

cases.title: Immediate persistence of changes to local storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes made during Markdown editing are reflected immediately in local storage to persist the current state of the note.

cases.title: New note creation enters edit mode immediately
cases.description: When a new note is created by clicking the 'Add note' button, it immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid='note-textarea') is visible for user input and the main content area (data-testid='note-main') remains hidden.

cases.title: Switching between edit and view modes via Edit button
cases.description: Users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button'), toggling the visibility between the main content area and the textarea accordingly.

cases.title: Automatic saving of typed changes to local storage
cases.description: All changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes note from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the delete button associated with a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes the corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and Display Saved Notes from LocalStorage on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that when the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves all saved notes from localStorage, dynamically creates a note div element with the class note containing tools with 'Edit' and 'Delete' buttons, a main div for content, and a textarea, rendering notes with content shown in the main div and the textarea hidden by default.

cases.title: Display Textarea and Hide Main Div for Retrieved Notes with No Content
cases.description: Verify that for retrieved notes that have no content, the application shows the textarea and hides the main div to allow immediate editing.

cases.title: Handle Empty LocalStorage on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that if localStorage is empty, no notes are shown on the page.

opinions.feedback: All test cases are well-structured, distinct, and directly supported by the requirements text without any blockers or redundancy issues.
All requirements have corresponding test cases covering their distinct operations, and no blockers or speculative/redundant cases were found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 includes multiple distinct behaviors: clicking the 'Add note' button creates and appends a <div> element with class 'note', includes a visible empty textarea inside each note, and supports multiple rapid clicks creating separate notes each with its own textarea. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 includes multiple distinct behaviors: user inputs or modifies Markdown content in the textarea, dynamic real-time rendering in the main display area with proper HTML formatting, handling complex Markdown and invalid Markdown without crashes displaying raw input upon exiting edit mode via the 'Edit' button, and immediate reflection of all changes in local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 includes multiple distinct behaviors: creating a new note on page load or via the add button entering edit mode immediately with a visible textarea and hidden main area, switching between edit and view modes via the 'Edit' button toggling visibility of the main area and textarea accordingly, and automatic saving of typed changes to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 includes multiple distinct behaviors: deleting a note by clicking its associated 'Delete' button, immediate removal of the targeted note from the DOM, and removal of the corresponding entry from localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 includes multiple distinct behaviors: retrieving saved notes from localStorage on page load, dynamically creating note div elements with tools containing 'Edit' and 'Delete' buttons and main and textarea divs, rendering retrieved notes with content shown in the main div and textarea hidden by default, showing the textarea and hiding the main div for notes with no content, showing no notes if localStorage is empty, and using the internal notes variable loaded via JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')).
